item.title: Rock Island City Council approves rezoning for 50-acre stretch by Illinois Route 92
item.description: Rock Island City Council voted Monday night to make more land along Illinois Highway 92 available for economic development. They unanimously approved rezoning about 50 acres south of 31st Avenue for industrial use. The area was originally zoned for nature conservation.
